Tracing.//RetentionDays: Days of trace_events history kept by TraceRetentionHostedService before the 6-hourly sweep deletes them. Override per-deployment via env Tracing__RetentionDays (TRACE_RETENTION_DAYS in deploy/.env). Min 1.

Simulation.//: Load-test device simulation (NFR-004 / TC-FW-065). OFF in normal deploys. When Enabled, ping/ssh/ansible steps are FAKED with synthetic latency — NO real device I/O — so a staging box can scale to thousands of synthetic devices. Boot is refused if Workflow:WorkerEnvironment=production. See docs/ops/load-testing.md.

Slack.//BotToken: Bot token (xoxb-…, scope chat:write) for the native slack_message snippet. Supply via env SLACK_BOT_TOKEN; empty disables the snippet with a clear error at run time.

Backend.//SelfBaseUrl: Loopback address the agent uses to call this backend's own /api specs (fw_*), from web chat as well as messaging / scheduled agent runs. Never derived from the incoming request's Host. Defaults to http://localhost:8080 — the container's internal Kestrel port; override only if Kestrel listens elsewhere.
